review_evidence: README identifies a three-day Lean tutorial whose formal modules cover logic, sets and functions, Schroeder-Bernstein, elementary number theory, structures, Gaussian integers, and differential calculus.

LeanInVienna.lean imports the substantive C02-C07 and C10 lesson modules, including C04_S03_The_Schroeder_Bernstein_Theorem, C05_S03_Infinitely_Many_Primes, and C06_S03_Building_the_Gaussian_Integers.
The source is an instructional formalization corpus rather than tooling-only material; tutorial/examples are retained under FILTER-001/FILTER-011 when they carry formal statements and proof patterns.
summary: Retain the Vienna Lean tutorial: its instructional modules contain formal mathematics, proof examples, and reusable interfaces across logic, number theory, algebra, sets/functions, and differential calculus.
